notes.title: Speedrun Record! (50:01)
notes.notes:
[h1]Fifty point zero-one Seconds[/h1]
The results are coming in more and more and the time is getting lower and lower. Jullees has achieved the world record with an insane 50:01.

Massive hats off to Jullees and then pop those hats back on because this ain't over. There is still time to be saved.

Who will be first get the mythical "sub 50"?


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iT8AYShGtUM&feature=youtu.be

[url=Julleess Twitter]https://twitter.com/JulleErlandsson/status/1071043518284656640[/url]

notes.title: LET'S ROLL
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33972730/84492af346e19e79e8f210de91a0d508c51c6cc9.png[/img]

[b]GIZMO LAUNCHED![/b]

It's happened! Gizmo is out! Start rolling, smashing and going fast in Professor Bolt's Arctic Station 4. Use a keyboard + mouse or perhaps sit cross legged, on your carpet, with a controller. Whichever you think is superior.

Three achievements to unlock, each more difficult than the last.

Listen to the occassional Bolt-Casts that broadcast around the globe.

Discover what's behind the secret Bolt Vault door.

Listen to the original score by Paul Michael Cardon! It's catchy. Trust me.

And of course, get the best time. :milo:

notes.title: Launching Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Alec here. :deadhusky:

We are super excited to release Gizmo tomorrow and let the public get their hands on it. Don't forget it will be [b]free[/b] and also [b]very fun[/b] and also [b]excellently voice acted by me.[/b]

This will mark our 4th game to be on Steam and that's kinda neat if you ask me.
